name: M. Loisel
summary: A little clerk at the Ministry of Public Instruction, economical and fond of his wife.

start.inner_state: Pleased with a fine opportunity he has got for her.

personality: Mild, thrifty, anxious to please her.
background: Has 18,000 francs left him by his father and is saving 400 for a gun to shoot larks at Nanterre on Sundays.
